description: Search the codex (codex.slopped.site), the encyclopedia of the slopped.site world: its people, creatures, places, objects, events, groups and concepts, from the Slopwright to the bosses in the games. Matches names, aliases and summaries. Use when someone asks who or what something in the slopped.site world is. Returns ids, kinds, one-line summaries and links; follow up with get_codex_entry or the slopped://codex/{id} resource.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "lamp", "lighthouse", "apprentice". Leave out to list everything (up to limit).

name: search_codex
title: Search the codex
